question: What are the AWS EC2 per-GB data transfer out rates above the free 100 GB, the CDT tiered overage price on Alibaba Cloud, and the access interfaces and egress terms of AIcrowd, Axelera Voyager and Cloudflare Project Alexandria?
why: The AWS pricing page text read carries the 100 GB allowance but not its rate table; the CDT pages read give the free quota but no tiered price; the AIcrowd, Axelera and Alexandria pages state no egress term and no API.
